title: prereg-deviation-v1 player output (task set v2)
description: Per-dimension deviation judgements comparing the paper to the preregistration.

dimension.description: Dimension id (must be one of input.dimensions).

deviation.description: True if the paper deviates from the preregistration on this dimension.

deviation_kind.description: If deviation=true, the kind of deviation (e.g. 'outcome_switch', 'sample_size_change'); null otherwise.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the deviation judgement.

registered_summary.description: Optional; may be null or omitted (v2). What the preregistration said about this dimension. Not scored.

paper_summary.description: Optional; may be null or omitted (v2). What the paper said about this dimension. Not scored.
